name: collide
description: Dependency-collision scanner for npm projects — pluggable scanner modules over one core engine.

scripts.demo: tsx test/build-vuln-lab.ts test/.vuln-lab && FORCE_COLOR=1 tsx src/cli.ts scan test/.vuln-lab/package-lock.json
scripts.go-demo: tsx test/build-go-lab.ts test/.go-lab && COLLIDE_GOMODCACHE=test/.go-lab/modcache FORCE_COLOR=1 tsx src/cli.ts scan test/.go-lab/go.sum
scripts.pip-demo: tsx test/build-pip-lab.ts test/.pip-lab && FORCE_COLOR=1 tsx src/cli.ts scan test/.pip-lab/requirements.txt
scripts.cargo-demo: tsx test/build-cargo-lab.ts test/.cargo-lab && COLLIDE_CARGO_SRC=test/.cargo-lab/cargo-src FORCE_COLOR=1 tsx src/cli.ts scan test/.cargo-lab/Cargo.lock
scripts.composer-demo: tsx test/build-composer-lab.ts test/.composer-lab && FORCE_COLOR=1 tsx src/cli.ts scan test/.composer-lab/composer.lock
